approvers: Site manager and project manager; I sign off myself
reason: Film and tape cost me about 12 a square metre all-in with my own labour and it works well enough. Paying about 19 for a coating means 60% more on every block, and I would need to see real damage savings to justify that.
objection: Why pay 60% more per m2 than film and tape when I only buy the cheapest thing that is good enough? I would also have to depend on an outside applicator and a 50% deposit, and nobody has shown me that my glazing damage claims are costing more than the 7 euro difference.
instead: Keep using self-adhesive film, plastic sheet and board with tape, applied and removed by my own crews.
would_change_my_mind: A site visit quote at or below about 13 per m2 all-in, or documented proof from a comparable Maltese block that it cut glazing replacement and snagging costs by more than the extra spend, with no deposit and 60-day terms.
